$schema_note: Vibe Assembly model-knowledge base. Curated capability CLASSES (stable) — not live benchmark scores. Refresh guidance in SOURCES. Allocators match on 'class' + 'strengths', never on made-up precision.

SOURCES.note: Re-check these when refreshing this file. All render leaderboards client-side; check them in a browser.

classes.reasoner: Deliberate multi-step thinking; best at root-cause diagnosis and hard planning. Slow and token-hungry.
classes.coder: Instruction-tuned specifically for code diffs; strong at allowlisted ticket execution and precise edits.
classes.flagship: Top general capability; strong long-context planning and architecture work.
classes.workhorse: Solid mid-tier general model; good quality/price/speed balance for conversation and light tickets.
classes.fast: Very fast, cheap, small-context; ideal for chat, status summaries, and formatting work.

boss.why: Blueprints need long context + strong planning; no terminal use.

chat.why: High-volume conversation; speed matters more than depth.

code.why: Precise diffs inside allowlists beat raw intelligence.

debug.why: Root-cause traversal rewards deliberate reasoning over speed.

hermes.why: Documentation is language-quality-bound, not latency-bound; mid-tier suffices.

models.name: Claude Sonnet family
models.notes: Excellent instruction-following for allowlisted edits; strong agentic coding record.

models.name: GPT-5.x mini/nano class
models.notes: Fast and cheap; good conversational quality.

models.name: GPT-5.x flagship class
models.notes: Strong general planning; widely available on routers.

models.name: DeepSeek R-series
models.notes: Deliberate reasoning; common free tier on community routers; slow but thorough.

models.name: DeepSeek V-series chat
models.notes: Strong open-weight general model; very router-available.

models.name: Qwen Coder series
models.notes: Purpose-built for code completion and diffs; frequent free tiers.

models.name: GLM flagship
models.notes: Competitive open-weight generalist; good agentic performance.

models.name: Kimi (Moonshot)
models.notes: Long context; generous free tiers on community routers.

models.name: Llama 4 class
models.notes: Ubiquitous open-weight baseline on every router.

models.name: Gemini Flash
models.notes: Huge context, very fast, generous free tier — excellent Chat/Boss-on-a-budget.

models.name: Gemini Pro
models.notes: Flagship-class with million-token context when available.

models.name: Grok class
models.notes: Available on some aggregators; solid generalist.

models.name: Nemotron ultra class
models.notes: Large-context reasoner variant; seen on NVIDIA-hosted free chains.

routers.note: API aggregators that expose many models behind one OpenAI-compatible key. Any of these works; set the combo via va models.
